PHLivePhotoView.doc: A view that displays a Live Photo—a picture that also includes motion and sound from the moments just before and after its capture.

PHPickerUpdateConfiguration.doc: An object that defines the aspects of a photo picker’s appearance that can change while it’s presented.

PHPickerViewController.doc: A view controller that provides the user interface for choosing assets from the photo library.

PHProjectAssetElement.doc: An element that represents a media asset within project section content.

PHProjectElement.doc: The superclass for all element objects.

PHProjectExtensionContext.doc: An object that provides Photos project extensions with access to the underlying project, as well as to the user’s photo library for editing.

PHProjectJournalEntryElement.doc: An element that represents a journal entry within project section content.

PHProjectMapElement.doc: An element that represents a map within project section content.

PHProjectRegionOfInterest.doc: A representation of a region of interest in a photo asset.

PHProjectSection.doc: A collection of content representing curated asset and text elements.

PHProjectSectionContent.doc: An object containing section elements and layout information for a single level of curation.

PHProjectTextElement.doc: An element that represents text within project section content.

PHProjectTypeDescription.doc: An extensible enumerator for PHProjectType that’s presented to users in the project picker.

PHContentEditingController.doc: A protocol your custom view controller class implements to provide a user interface for your Photos extension.

PHLivePhotoViewDelegate.doc: The PHLivePhotoViewDelegate protocol describes messages sent by a PHLivePhotoView instance in response to playback events when playing the motion and sound content associated with a Live Photo. To receive these messages, implement the methods in this protocol in one of your controller objects and assign that object to the delegate property of a Live Photo view.

PHProjectExtensionController.doc: A protocol defining the life cycle and supported types of project extensions.

PHProjectTypeDescriptionDataSource.doc: A protocol that you use to provide the project with type description data.

PHProjectTypeDescriptionInvalidator.doc: A protocol that you use to tell the project when and how to invalidate type and footer text.

PHLivePhotoViewContentMode.doc: The enumerated Live Photo content modes.

PHLivePhotoViewContentModeAspectFill.doc: A mode that resizes the content to fill its horizontal or vertical dimension.

PHLivePhotoViewContentModeAspectFit.doc: A mode that resizes the content to fit the view’s bounds, while preserving the content’s aspect ratio.

PHLivePhotoViewPlaybackStyle.doc: Options for how much of the motion and sound content of a Live Photo to play, used in the startPlaybackWithStyle: method and in messages to the view’s delegate object.

PHLivePhotoViewPlaybackStyleFull.doc: Plays back the entire motion and sound content of the Live Photo, including transition effects at the start and end.

PHLivePhotoViewPlaybackStyleHint.doc: Plays back only a brief section of the motion content of the Live Photo, without sound.

PHLivePhotoViewPlaybackStyleUndefined.doc: This value is invalid for use.

PHPickerCapabilities.doc: Options that customize the look and behavior of the photos picker.

PHPickerCapabilitiesCollectionNavigation.doc: A capability that corresponds to a sidebar or the Albums tab.

PHPickerCapabilitiesNone.doc: An option that represents no capabilities.

PHPickerCapabilitiesSearch.doc: A capability that corresponds to the search bar.

PHPickerCapabilitiesSelectionActions.doc: A cabability that represents the Cancel and Add buttons.

PHPickerCapabilitiesSensitivityAnalysisI.doc: A capability that prompts for confirmation if a person selects a photo that contains nudity.

PHPickerCapabilitiesStagingArea.doc: A capability that corresponds to an area in which the selected photos display.

PHPickerConfigurationAssetRepresentation.doc: Constants identifying the mode the system uses when many representations exist for an asset.
A mode that indicates that the system chooses the appropriate asset representation.
A mode that uses the most compatible asset representation.
A mode that uses the current representation to avoid transcoding, if possible.

PHPickerConfigurationSelection.doc: Options that represent differing selection behavior.

PHPickerConfigurationSelectionContinuous.doc: An option that provides the app a person’s selection immediately.
An option that provides the app a person’s selection immediately and displays selected photos with a numbered badge.

PHPickerConfigurationSelectionDefault.doc: An option that provides selected photos to the app in the default order after the user confirms the selection.

PHPickerConfigurationSelectionOrdered.doc: An option that provides selected photos to the app in the chosen order after the user confirms the selection.

PHProjectCreationSource.doc: Defines the source of a project extension.

PHProjectSectionType.doc: The intended usage of the section: cover, content, or auxiliary.

PHProjectTextElementType.doc: An enumeration of the type of text element.

+livePhotoBadgeImageWithOptions:.doc: Returns an icon image for the specified Live Photo semantic options.

-startPlaybackWithStyle:.doc: Begins playback of Live Photo content in the view.

-stopPlayback.doc: Stops playback of a Live Photo.

-stopPlaybackAnimated:.doc: Stops playback of a Live Photo in an animated manner.

-deselectAssetsWithIdentifiers:.doc: Deselects assets that are in a selected state.

-initWithConfiguration:.doc: Creates a new picker view controller with the configuration you specify.

-moveAssetWithIdentifier:afterAssetWithI.doc: Reorders assets that are in a selected state.

-scrollToInitialPosition.doc: Resets the visible photo thumbnails by scrolling the view to the picker’s initial position.

-updatePickerUsingConfiguration:.doc: Customizes your app’s photo picker according to the given configuration.

-zoomIn.doc: Changes the picker’s content scale by making the photo thumbnails larger in the view.

-zoomOut.doc: Changes the picker’s content scale by making the photo thumbnails smaller in the view.

-showEditorForAsset:.doc: Invokes the built-in photo editor for the given asset.

-updatedProjectInfoFromProjectInfo:compl.doc: Creates an updated PHProjectInfo instance from existing project information and current assets.

-initWithProjectType:title:attributedDes.doc: A designated initializer for project type descriptions with lazily fetched subtypes and an attributed description string.
A designated initializer for project type descriptions with the full subtype hierarchy specified up front and an attributed string for description text.

-initWithProjectType:title:description:i.doc: A convenience initializer without subtype descriptions.
A designated initializer for project type descriptions with lazily fetched subtypes and a standard description string.
A designated initializer for project type descriptions with the full subtype hierarchy specified up front and a standard string for description text.

audioVolume.doc: The audio gain to apply to the Live Photo’s movie content during playback.

contentMode.doc: The mode in which the view displays its content.

delegate.doc: An object to be notified when Live Photo playback begins or ends.

livePhoto.doc: The Live Photo displayed in the view.

livePhotoBadgeView.doc: A view for displaying Live Photo status.

muted.doc: A Boolean value that determines whether the view plays the audio content of its Live Photo.

playbackGestureRecognizer.doc: A gesture recognizer that controls playback of the Live Photo in the view.

edgesWithoutContentMargins.doc: The portions of a photo picker’s permiter that are borderless.

searchText.doc: The search text for the picker.

selectionLimit.doc: The maximum number of selections the user can make.

configuration.doc: The configuration you specify when creating the picker.

init(configuration:).doc: Creates a new picker view controller with the configuration you specify.

updatePicker(using:).doc: Customizes your app’s photo picker according to the given configuration.

annotation.doc: A string annotation attached to the asset.

cloudAssetIdentifier.doc: The asset’s identifier in the cloud.

cropRect.doc: A rectangle defining the cropped portion of the asset.

horizontallyFlipped.doc: A Boolean indicating whether the asset is vertically flipped.

regionsOfInterest.doc: An array of regions of interest in the photo asset.

verticallyFlipped.doc: A Boolean indicating whether the asset is vertically flipped.

placement.doc: A rectangle defining where an element is placed in grid space coordinates.

weight.doc: A value between 0 and 1 representing relative significance of the element in its section.

photoLibrary.doc: A read-only version of the photo library being modified.

project.doc: A read-only version of the project being edited.

PHProjectCreationSource.doc: Defines the source of a project extension.

brandingEnabled.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether branding was enabled in the source project.

creationSource.doc: The source from which the project was created.

pageNumbersEnabled.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether page numbering was enabled in the source project.

productIdentifier.doc: The product identifier of the originating Apple Print Product.

projectType.doc: The project type that the user selected from the project extension options.

sections.doc: An array of project sections, each containing one or more section content objects.

themeIdentifier.doc: The product theme identifier of the originating Apple Print Product.

assetElement.doc: An optional asset to represent the date in the journal entry.

date.doc: The date of the journal entry.

textElement.doc: Descriptive text for the date of the entry.

annotations.doc: An array of optional annotations attached to the map.

centerCoordinate.doc: The coordinates of the center of the map.

mapType.doc: The type of map in the project.

PHProjectRegionOfInterestIdentifier.doc: A descriptor identifying a region of interest.

rect.doc: The rectangle representing the region’s location.

PHProjectSectionType.doc: The intended usage of the section: cover, content, or auxiliary.

sectionType.doc: The intended usage of the section: cover, content, or auxiliary.

aspectRatio.doc: The aspect ratio of the full content layout, defined as width over height.

backgroundColor.doc: The background color of the section content when created from an Apple Print Product.

cloudAssetIdentifiers.doc: An array containing all cloud asset identifiers referenced in the content.

elements.doc: An array of asset, text, or journal entry elements contained in the content.

numberOfColumns.doc: The number of columns if section content is displayed in a grid layout.

PHProjectTextElementType.doc: An enumeration of the type of text element.

attributedText.doc: The stylized attributed string for the text element as presented to the user in Photos.

text.doc: The raw unformatted string for the text element.

textElementType.doc: The enumerated type of the text element.

canProvideSubtypes.doc: A Boolean variable indicating whether subtypes can be fetched from the data source.

image.doc: An optional image associated with the project type in the picker.

localizedAttributedDescription.doc: The localized attributed description of the project type as shown to the user.

localizedDescription.doc: The localized description of the project type as shown to the user.

localizedTitle.doc: The localized title of the project type as shown to the user.

projectType.doc: An identifier for the project type.

subtypeDescriptions.doc: An array of type descriptions used for subtype descriptions.
